name: real_course_template
description: TEMPLATE for a course file of a real place. Copy it, rename it, and replace every number: none of them is real. Coordinates are in meters in the course frame: the origin is the middle of the start line, +X is the direction of travel at the start, +Y is to the left. The robot must be switched on standing on the start line, facing along +X, because its odometry starts at zero there.

gps.how_to_fill: datum_lat and datum_lon: stand the robot on the middle of the start line and read gps/fix for a minute; use the average. x_axis_bearing_deg: the compass bearing of the first straight (north 0, east 90). start_box: from how far behind the line to how far ahead of it, and how far to each side, the robot may stand when a run is armed. boundary_half_width_m: how far from the centerline the robot may be before the run is stopped; with a plain GPS fix allow for 2 m of error. centerline: a closed line around the course, a point every few meters; the boundary is measured from it. Without a centerline the boundary is a circle of that radius around the start line.
